scope: Selected-window exploratory PPG event audit; conditioned on prior disagreement selection, not population accuracy.

protocol.selection: Existing stage-1 cardiac windows with state=no_rule_flag and detector count difference >20%; no newly tuned detector parameters or timing correction.
protocol.pairing: Legacy earliest-available one-to-one rule, applied at run level. Reference-side and detection-side window counts are reported separately across boundaries.
protocol.references: 5000 source physiological markers, from the same pulse-oximeter recording; not independent ECG events or MRI TTL.
protocol.alignment: SourceSliceStart/Stop and original sample indices; exported samples must exactly equal the indicated raw source slice. No estimated time shift is applied.
protocol.context_check: Compare unchanged detectors applied once to each padded run versus once to the complete source recording. These are diagnostic context checks, not external validation.
protocol.zoom_selection: Five-second subwindow with the largest absolute A/B event-count difference; first subwindow resolves ties. Selected for inspection, not random sampling.
protocol.visual_review: AI-assisted descriptions may be added separately. Independent human pulse adjudication and ECG validation remain pending.
protocol.external_basis: PPG detectors can target peaks or systolic upslopes: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9393905/ . This does not identify the correct events in these data.

manual_event_truth_status: Pending; no true/false heartbeat labels are assigned.
